set A2 example ```python
from vatkit import vat_of

vat_of("100.00", "DE")      # Decimal('19.00')
vat_of("0.05", "DE")        # Decimal('0.01'), 0.0095 half up
```

set A3 example ```python
from vatkit import gross

gross("100", "FR")              # Decimal('120.00')
gross("10.00", "DE", "books")   # Decimal('10.70')
```

set A4 example ```python
from vatkit import net

net("119.00", "DE")         # Decimal('100.00'); the VAT in it is 19.00
```

set A5 example ```python
from vatkit import split

split([("10.00", None), ("10.00", None), ("20.00", "books")], "DE")
# {"19%": {"net": 20.00, "vat": 3.80, "gross": 23.80},
#  "7%":  {"net": 20.00, "vat": 1.40, "gross": 21.40}}
```

set A6 example ```python
from vatkit import money

money("1234.5", "DE")       # '1.234,50 €'
money("1234.5")             # '€1,234.50'
```

set A7 example ```python
from vatkit import round_cents

round_cents("0.005")        # Decimal('0.01')
round_cents("0.0049")       # Decimal('0.00')
```

set A8 example ```python
from vatkit import check_vat_number

check_vat_number("de 123 456 789")   # 'DE123456789'
check_vat_number("DE12345")          # BadVatNumber
```
